items.title: 9 Automation Projects Completed
items.description: Nine automation projects built in a single session to systematically automate Nomads hostel operations. Prioritized: native MEWS booking (PR #32), POS-to-MEWS sync, Klaviyo enhancement, command center, agent swarm, revenue optimizer, guest portal, ops dashboard, review manager.

items.title: Ao Nang Properties Market Position
items.description: Nomads operates 2 properties in Ao Nang Krabi area: Nomads Ao Nang Beach (rank #2, THB 999, 9.6/10 rating) and Base Ao Nang Beachfront (rank #4, THB 999, 9.4/10 rating). Both priced ~60% below market average of THB 2484. Competitive pricing strategy with high ratings.

items.title: Hostelworld Price Monitor Migrated to Agent Browser
items.description: Hostelworld price monitoring system migrated from broken Puppeteer scraper to Agent Browser with mobile viewport. Puppeteer was returning incorrect prices (THB 999 vs actual THB 1,098) due to anti-bot protection. Agent Browser provides accurate real-time data.

items.title: Daily Telegram Price Reports Configured
items.description: Cron job configured to send daily Hostelworld price reports at 8am Thailand time via Telegram. Reports include: Nomads Ao Nang Beach (price, rank, rating), Base Ao Nang Beachfront (price, rank, rating), top 5 competitors, and market insights. Uses Agent Browser CLI for token-efficient scraping.

items.title: Poster POS System Terminology
items.description: Trevor clarified Poster POS structure: Workshops are accounting categories (not physical stations), Spots are POS terminals/locations (also called locations), Categories are menu groupings. This corrected earlier mapping assumptions for MEWS integration.

items.title: Corrected POS to MEWS Mapping
items.description: Mapping corrected after Trevor's clarification: Poster Spots (locations) → MEWS Outlets, Poster Workshops (accounting categories) → MEWS Accounting Categories. POS-MEWS sync project updated with two distinct mapping sections in dashboard UI.

items.title: No Headless Sync CLI Available
items.description: Investigated headless Obsidian sync options after Trevor requested terminal-based trigger. Found: Obsidian Sync is GUI-only feature, no official headless sync CLI exists. obsidian-cli by Yakitrak supports note operations but not sync. Workarounds: Obsidian Git plugin, Syncthing, Resilio Sync, or iCloud/Dropbox.

items.title: Obsidian CLI Limitation Discovery
items.description: Researched obsidian-cli by Yakitrak (GitHub) for terminal-based Obsidian operations. Tool provides create, edit, delete, search, daily notes, and set-default-vault commands. Does NOT support sync functionality.

items.title: Hostelworld Platform Data
items.description: Hostel booking and review platform used for competitive benchmarking. Shows hostel rankings, prices, and ratings for destinations worldwide. Ao Nang Krabi market data as of 2026-01-30: 31 hostels, average price THB 2484, price range THB 332-19,990.

items.title: Anti-Bot Protection Breaks Puppeteer Scraping
items.description: Hostelworld has anti-bot protection that prevents Puppeteer-based scraping from working correctly. Scrapers would timeout or return stale/incorrect prices. Solution: Use Agent Browser with real Chrome browser and mobile viewport emulation for accurate data.

items.title: Selected Agent Browser for Web Scraping
items.description: Decision made to use Agent Browser skill for Hostelworld price scraping instead of Puppeteer. Agent Browser provides real Chrome browser with mobile viewport emulation, bypasses anti-bot protection, and is most token-efficient approach (LLM only used for analysis, not scraping).

items.title: Market Decline on January 29, 2026
items.description: Stock market down primarily due to Microsoft earnings disappointing traders and weighing heavily on tech stocks. Fed kept interest rates unchanged (maintaining cautious stance with inflation above 2% target). Gold prices pulled back after hitting fresh record highs. S&P 500 hit 7,000 for first time then pulled back after Fed decision.

items.title: Selected for Token-Efficient Web Scraping
items.description: Agent Browser skill selected as the most token-friendly web scraping solution for Hostelworld price monitoring. Provides real Chrome browser with mobile viewport, bypasses anti-bot protection, and operates via CLI with 0 LLM tokens for the scraping itself. LLM only involved for analysis and report formatting.

items.title: Connector API Uses AccessToken Only
items.description: MEWS Connector API authentication for nomads-ops-center uses AccessToken only (not ClientToken + AccessToken as documented). Per Trevor's confirmation on 2026-01-30: integration is installed per property on MEWS side, so single AccessToken identifies both app and property.
